title: Aromatic Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: A peppery and molten weeknight Brazilian dish featuring sherry vinegar, this recipe is perfect for a quick dinner, and is FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together sherry vinegar, olive oil, garlic, black pepper, and salt.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Wrap each skewer in a banana leaf, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Steam the skewers over boiling water for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
